title: Types and schemas trace to open standards
description: Stakeholder directive, in the context of Stakeholder directive: open standards for types and schemas; RFC 8610 Concise Data Definition Language (CDDL); HL7 FHIR R5 Data Types; W3C XML Schema 1.1 Part 2: Datatypes; W3C JSON-LD 1.1; W3C Shapes Constraint Language (SHACL); ITU-T X.680 ASN.1 (free); RFC 7493 I-JSON.

statements.label: Types and schemas trace to open standards
statements.requirement: Every data type in the API contract, wire schema and payload models SHALL trace to an openly available standard: IETF CBOR/CDDL (RFC 8949, RFC 8610) for the wire format, HL7 FHIR data types and W3C XSD datatypes for payload elements, W3C JSON-LD and SHACL for payload semantics, ITU-T X.680 for certificates, and I-JSON (RFC 7493) for JSON files. Paywalled standards SHALL NOT be used as type or schema references.
